name: South China Karst
description: South China Karst is a sprawling network of limestone landscapes across Guizhou, Guangxi, Yunnan and Chongqing in southern China. Its sights include the grey "stone forest" of Shilin, whose rock spires rise like petrified trees, and the green cone and tower peaks of Libo. Wulong adds giant sinkholes, natural stone bridges and vast caves, making this a showcase of dramatic scenery.
